description: Florida health-care license verification (Department of Health, MQA): search by name (and city) or license number within a board (medicine, osteopathic, nursing, dentistry, pharmacy, psychology...): license number, name, profession, city and status, plus match count. With a license number also issue and expiry dates, address of record, discipline on file and prescriber flags. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

board.description: Board: acupuncture, athletic training, chiropractic medicine, clinical laboratory personnel, dentistry, hearing aid specialists, massage therapy, medicine, naturopathic medicine, nursing, occupational therapy, opticianry, optometry, orthotists and prosthetists, osteopathic medicine, pharmacy, physical therapy, podiatric medicine, psychology, respiratory care, school psychology, emergency medical services, certified social workers, midwifery, dietetics and nutrition, electrolysis, genetic counseling, nursing home administrators, speech-language pathology and audiology, csw/mft/mhc (default any)

licenseNumber.description: License number, e.g. ME131739 (returns the full record)

status.description: active (default: practicing statuses), inactive or all
